introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, curve your back upward and let your head come down. Repeat the exercise.

Do it slowly with each step of this exercise.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start with your knees and hands on the floor. Put your hands a little forward, widen your knees and put your toes together. 

Take a breath, then exhale and sit back. Try to make your butt touch your heels. Relax your elbows, make your forehead touch the floor and try to lower your chest close to the floor. Hold this position.

Keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back. Make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears during the exercise.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start with your hands rested on your hips and your feet shoulder width apart. 

Tilt your head towards your left shoulder and then to the right. 

Don’t move your shoulders when you tilt your head.
name: HEAD TILT

tips.text: Please don\'t move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your right leg up and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor. 

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Exhale, lift your left leg up and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Keep your other arm extended to the side on the floor.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Hold this position for seconds.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe slowly while holding yourself up.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Bring your chin down to your chest, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen look up towards the ceiling, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: UP & DOWN NODS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't turn your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Turn your head to the left, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen turn your head to the right, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TURNS

tips.text: Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand or sit with your arms at your sides. Roll your shoulders up towards your ears, then roll them back and squeeze, then roll them down. Repeat the exercise.
name: CLOCKWISE SHOULDER ROLLS

tips.text: Please just move your shoulders, and keep your neck relaxed.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand or sit with arms at your sides. Roll your shoulders back and squeeze, then roll them up towards your ears, then roll them down. Repeat the exercise.
name: COUNTERCLOCKWISE SHOULDER ROLLS

tips.text: Please just move your shoulders, and keep your neck relaxed.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. \n\nSlowly bend your right arm; meanwhile, bend your upper body to the right. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. \n\nSlowly bend your left arm; meanwhile, bend your upper body to the left. Breathe slowly and deeply. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the right. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the left. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie down on your back with your legs extended.\n\nBend your knees and bring them up toward your chest; hug your knees with both hands. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs stretched, hands at your sides and palms up. Take deep relaxation on the floor.\n\nTake deep breaths through your nose. Connect your body to the breath.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Take deep breaths through your nose.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder width apart. 

Raise your hands overhead with palms up toward the ceiling. 

Use one of your hands to grab the other. Bend your body side to side.
name: STANDING BACK STRETCHES

tips.text: Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you come back.
This exercise helps stretch your spine.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Draw your belly in and tuck your tailbone down. Roll your shoulders back and down. 

Bend your upper body forward and rest your hands on your legs. Bend from your hips instead of your waist. 

Breathe naturally. Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine. Hold this position.
name: HALF FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Bend from your hips instead of your waist.
Keep your legs straight but don\'t lock your knees.
Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
This exercise strengthens your back.

introduce: Start on all fours with your hips up in an upside-down \'V\' shape. Alternately lift and lower your heels.\n\nBreathe regularly throughout the pose.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Breathe regularly.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position, but with your right leg on the floor. Tuck your pelvis in and sink your hips. 

Raise your arms up by your ears with your palms facing each other. Look straight ahead. Hold this position.

Take full and deep breaths. Lengthen your spine each time you exhale.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-distance apart. Take your left foot forward while keeping your right leg straight.  

Turn your right foot 60 degrees to your right. Lower your body until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. 

Raise your arms toward the ceiling with your palms facing each other. 

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely. Hold this position.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ LEFT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-distance apart. Take your right foot forward while keeping your left leg straight. 

Turn your left foot 60 degrees to your left. Lower your body until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. 

Raise your arms toward the ceiling with your palms facing each other. 

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely. Hold this position.
name: WARRIOR Ⅰ RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and legs.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your left foot to the left and your right foot 60 degrees to the left.

Lower your body until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Raise your arms to your sides with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. 

Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely. Hold this position.
name: WARRIOR Ⅱ LEFT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Keep your torso in the middle.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
Don\'t let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your right foot to the right and your left foot 60 degrees to the right.

Lower your body until your right thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Raise your arms to your sides with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your right hand. 

Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely. Hold this position.
name: WARRIOR Ⅱ RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Keep your torso in the middle.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs, shoulders, and back.
This exercise stretches your chest, hips, and hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Start in a lunge position, but with your left leg on the floor. Tuck your pelvis in and sink your hips. 

Raise your arms up by your ears with your palms facing each other. Look straight ahead. Hold this position.

Take full and deep breaths. Lengthen your spine each time you exhale.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips, chest, and belly.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and shoulders.
Breathe regularly.
